text:
alex: Heads up - PR #45821 is blocked, CI failing on render_snapshot_test only on mac-latest. Need approval after rerun or snapshot update. Can someone with mac approval take a look? :mac:

marie: I saw that, seems nondet. It passes locally for me. Which job is it? link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/builds/45821

dev-ci-bot: Build failed: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/builds/45821/jobs/12

dev-ci-bot: Failing step: "integration:render-snapshots-mac" 

sana: pinging @tj and @alex for quick eyes. If it's snapshot drift we can update, but want to avoid masking a real regression.

tj: I can run a targeted rerun on that job, doing now. Will report back in ~2m.

alex: thanks tj. if rerun still flakes, I'll open a follow-up to update the golden and mention the windows runner too.

tj: rerun done, flakes again. attaching failing stderr:
```
E        AssertionError: expected image hashes to match
    -  expected: 7f3a2c...
    +  actual:   9b2f11...
   at tests/integration/render_snapshot_test.py:142
```

marie: Looks like a consistent pixel shift not a timeout. Could be because of font fallback on mac runner. @sana do we pin fonts anywhere in tests?

sana: we don't. There's a helper to normalize fonts but not applied here. Option A: update golden with note. Option B: normalize output in test. I can do the normalization change in a follow-up if we want to be strict.

alex: For this PR I'm leaning to update snapshot since change is visual and intentional. Plan: update golden, run full CI, get 1 approval and merge in the staggered merge window (we're in 'merge-grace' window until 18:00 PST). Anyone able to approve after green?

marie: I can approve after you push snapshot update and CI passes.

tj: +1 to snapshot update for now. If we see more noise we should add font normalization.

dev-ci-bot: New build queued: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/builds/45822

alex: pushed snapshot update in PR branch, triggered targeted rerun for the mac job: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/builds/45822/jobs/15

tj: mac job green now. Full CI still running but no other failures so far.

marie: reviewed the change, looks fine. Approved :thumbsup:

alex: thanks @marie and @tj. merging in 5m unless anyone objects.

sana: no objections, please file a follow-up issue to add font normalization for render tests.

alex: filed ISSUE-729: add font normalization to render_snapshot_test, assigning to @sana. Merging now. :shipit:
